title: Resolution urging Albany to require automated solar permitting
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass and the Governor to sign S.5781/A.6270, which would require municipalities with more than 5,000 residents to adopt an automated permitting platform for residential rooftop solar installations by June 30, 2026. The platform would allow instant review and approval of standard applications, remote inspections and online payments. It aims to reduce permitting delays and costs that can discourage homeowners from installing solar panels.
